package store

import "github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"

// ByScope hands back a map keyed by scope name, each value a *Queries widened to every scope --
// another shape a single-*ast.StarExpr unwrap never reaches.
func ByScope(pool *pgxpool.Pool) map[string]*Queries {
	return map[string]*Queries{"all": {pool: pool, scopes: Scopes{"personal", "work", "client-globex"}}}
}
